title: Aquarius — Cosmic Shift Arriving Today

youtube_description: Discover the cosmic storm shaking your Air sign today, from a powerful sextile between Uranus and Neptune to a tense Mars‑Pluto square igniting romance and finances. If you want to know exactly how these transits will shape your love life and career, stick around. Comment your sign for a personalized reading!
script_text: Stop, Aquarius, the stars are screaming at you right now! Uranus, ruler of your Air sign, is forming a sextile to Neptune in your 8th House, awakening hidden desires and sudden insights. Meanwhile, a tense square between Mars in your 5th House and Pluto in the 2nd House warns of impulsive spending and power struggles in romance. Your love life is buzzing as Venus whispers through your 7th House, bringing a chance encounter with a kindred spirit if you're single, while those in relationships should watch for hidden jealousy resurfacing. In your 10th House career, Mercury's recent retrograde fallout clears now, giving you the clarity to negotiate a promotion or close a lucrative deal that lands in July. Today a warning: avoid signing any legal paperwork under pressure—trust your gut instead. Follow for tomorrow's reading and unlock more cosmic secrets.
